attribute_fields.COMMENTS: California military retirement exemption (2025). New $20,000 exemption with AGI limits: $125k single, $250k joint. SBP payments receive same treatment. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, CA FTB.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize CA military retirement exemption calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "CA Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef

condition_details.condition_postfix: result.filing_status "single" strcasecmp 0 eq result.agi result.ca_military_agi_limit_single le and
result.filing_status "married_filing_jointly" strcasecmp 0 eq result.filing_status "head_of_household" strcasecmp 0 eq or result.agi result.ca_military_agi_limit_joint le and

action_details.action_comment: Apply CA $20,000 military retirement exemption (Single, AGI ≤ $125k)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption_amount min /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CA military retirement exemption (Single): $" result.ca_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ca_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Apply CA $20,000 military retirement exemption (Joint, AGI ≤ $250k)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption_amount min /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.ca_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CA military retirement exemption (Joint/HOH): $" result.ca_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.ca_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No CA military retirement exemption (AGI exceeds limit)
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef result.military_retirement_pay /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"CA military retirement: NO EXEMPTION (AGI exceeds limit). Retirement: $" result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", AGI: $" strconcat result.agi cvs strconcat ", Fully taxable" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.ca_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No CA military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto
